title: gete.yaml
description: Project-wide declaration: where agents are deployed, which policies apply, and which connections exist.

project.description: GCP project that holds the reasoning engines, service accounts, and secrets.

location.description: Region of the reasoning engines. Agent Engine has no global region. Spliced into the Vertex AI host name, so the shape is part of a URL.
Where Gemini Enterprise holds the engine, usually global. Becomes a path segment of every Discovery Engine URL.

connections.description: Overrides for catalog entries, or private definitions. Each value has the connection shape; catalog ids may give only the differing keys.
